meta_description: Caesium is a free, open source, online compression tool for photos and images (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF), supporting batch, preview and many more. Caesium saves space and makes uploads faster.

cc_consent_description: We use cookies to measure our audience with Google Analytics and improve your experience. Analytics cookies are only set with your consent. Read our Privacy Policy.
cc_section_usage_description: We use cookies to ensure the website works correctly and to understand how it is used. You can choose to opt in or out of each category at any time.
cc_section_necessary_description: These cookies are essential for the website to function and cannot be disabled.
cc_section_analytics_description: These cookies let us measure traffic and understand how the website is used through Google Analytics. They are only enabled with your consent.
cc_section_more_description: For more details, see our Cookie Policy and Privacy Policy.
features_secure_desc: Images are processed directly in your browser. No data is sent to our servers.
features_fast_desc: Employs advanced compression algorithms for maximum size reduction with minimal quality loss.
features_free_desc: Free and open source, made to stay accessible, transparent, and community-driven.
how_step1_desc: Drag & drop or select your images.
how_step2_desc: Choose your desired quality and format settings.
how_step3_desc: Click compress and get your optimized images instantly.
